# nxos_poe (Resource)

This resource can manage the PoE (Power over Ethernet) configuration on NX-OS devices, including instance, logging level and interface settings.

### API Documentation

- [poeEntity](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Power%20over%20Ethernet/poe:Entity/)
- [poeInst](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Power%20over%20Ethernet/poe:Inst/)
- [poeModLogLevel](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Power%20over%20Ethernet/poe:ModLogLevel/)
- [poePhysIf](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Power%20over%20Ethernet/poe:PhysIf/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nxos_poe" "example" {
  instance_admin_state = "enabled"
  instance_control     = "stateful-ha"
  logging_level        = 3
  interfaces = {
    "eth1/10" = {
      max_consumption          = 20000
      port_default_consumption = 10000
      port_mode                = "static"
      port_police              = "log"
      port_priority            = "high"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `instance_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
  - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`
- `instance_control` (String) The control state.
  - Choices: `stateful-ha`
- `interfaces` (Attributes Map) List of PoE interfaces.
  - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `logging_level` (Number) Logging Level.
  - Range: `0`-`7`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The distinguished name of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Optional:

- `max_consumption` (Number) POE interface's current max port consumption.
  - Range: `4000`-`60000`
- `port_default_consumption` (Number) POE interface's default port consumption.
  - Range: `4000`-`30000`
- `port_mode` (String) POE interface's current port mode.
  - Choices: `Default`, `never`, `auto`, `static`
- `port_police` (String) POE interface's current port police action.
  - Choices: `Default`, `errdisable`, `log`
- `port_priority` (String) POE interface's current port Priority.
  - Choices: `low`, `high`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = nxos_poe.example
  identity = {}
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema


#### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Terraform's `import` block requires a non-empty `id` value, so this format cannot be used to
# import nxos_poe for the default device. Use the `terraform import` command
# below, or identity-based import shown above, instead.
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nxos_poe.example ""
```
